status: frozen before the measurement recorded in receipt-*.json; these are the only thresholds this lane has
go_rule: GO if and only if every criterion below holds on every case of corpus.json with zero mismatches and zero unexercised cells; otherwise NO-GO. Neither verdict adopts the cursor: the layer stays default-off and no editor command reaches it.

verdict_fields: report.failure.category when the report carries a failure object
comparison.verdict_report: the whole parsed report object (byte-for-byte after JSON parsing), so a moved span or a renamed field also fails the cell
comparison.admitted_source: the literal bytes of engine/module-1.noble written by `noble editor admit JSON --emit DIR`, which are the bytes the editor route passes to submission (the same bytes the report names in module.source_sha256)
comparison.module: module.source_sha256 and module.wasm_sha256 from the admit report

criteria.name: identity reconstruction
criteria.statement: For every node address of every corpus tree, a cursor addressed with that node_path must report the same address and reconstruct the original tree: no navigation and no replacement leaves the node tree unchanged.
criteria.check: address sweep per case: Cursor::at(tree, address).node_path() == address and encode(reconstruct()) == the case's original document

criteria.name: documented moves
criteria.statement: Every documented navigation step must move the focus to the address the corpus states, and the reconstruction after the sequence must equal the case's original tree.
criteria.check: each case.sequences entry: per-step address equality, then tree equality against the case tree

criteria.name: replacement equals the JSON edit
criteria.statement: Every documented replacement must produce the node tree of the corpus's independent JSON edit, and the two trees must have equal analyze and admit verdicts. A hole-free pair must also have equal admitted_source bytes and equal module digests.
criteria.check: each case.replacements entry: tree equality against replacement.tree, then the four CLI runs (analyze and admit over both documents), then the byte and digest comparison when both admits succeed

criteria.name: holes still refuse admission
criteria.statement: Any tree that still contains a Hole is refused by `noble editor admit` before any submission, with accepted_program_created false and no guest request. When the tree's own node syntax builds, the refusal is the hole refusal and it names the first hole's own node_path; a tree whose syntax refuses earlier never reaches hole acceptance and must refuse at that earlier stage instead.
criteria.check: every hole-bearing document in the corpus and every replacement tree that keeps a hole: admit exits 2 with accepted_program_created false and guest_requests 0; when failure.source_stage is acceptance, failure.node_path_status is mapped and failure.node_path equals the cursor's own first-hole address

criteria.name: illegal moves refuse before admission
criteria.statement: Every illegal move the corpus documents (focus off the end or through a non-quotation, entering a non-quotation or an empty quotation, leaving the root list) must be refused with its own class before any editor command runs.
criteria.check: each case.refusals entry: the refusal class matches, and the harness's editor-command counter does not increase while the refusal is produced

criteria.name: default-off
criteria.statement: No shipped path reaches the cursor: the artifact the integration test invokes must contain no cursor code, and `noble editor analyze` / `noble editor admit` must keep the JSON ingress, report schema and exit codes they have today.
criteria.check: the bytes of CARGO_BIN_EXE_noble contain none of the cursor's refusal-class literals; the module declaration is `#[cfg(test)] mod zipper;`; every analyze/admit report in this receipt is the unchanged noble-editor-report/v1 or noble-core-report/v1 shape

non_gates: the cited paper's prefetching timings, trail-depth affine cost bounds and Lean completeness results are the authors' claims; nothing in this lane measures or gates them
no threshold on cursor move cost, reconstruction cost, or trail depth beyond the ingress's own node, depth, byte and work limits
no requirement that any editor command, report field or default path gain the cursor
reopen: a corpus case or criterion may be extended only by a commit that freezes the extension before a new receipt is produced
adopting the cursor into a default editor path requires a separate issue, a spec change, and a fresh receipt under the extended criteria
